Naming a point or a line

Software presentation ››

Naming a point or a line on the fly.


Only points and lines can be given a name.


When a point or a line is created, an editor appears on the figure, allowing you to name it.

If you don't wish this point or line to be named, just select another tool or click on the figure.


Naming a point or a line after it's creation.


Use tool of the upper toolbar, click on the point or the line then fill in the dialog box.


Moving a name of a point or a line.


Use icon of the upper toolbar, the drag the name when the mouse pointer is a hand.
